audioProvenance: Fresh 16kHz mono extraction of the original screen recording is byte-identical to the reference audio already used by frozen DTW alignment.
assayCalibration: Known synthetic note attacks exposed saturation/early-edge bias in the first exploratory frontend. The final method uses linear-magnitude flux and active-only normalization, with a bounded-latency synthetic regression test. Earlier log-flux v001/v002 reports are retained but superseded.
kissMeSafety: The diagnostic requires an explicit composition id and native, unwarped visual labels. The registry caps Kiss Me at 150 reference-clock seconds even if a larger or no cutoff is requested. WANE remains unrestricted.
interpretation: This is not accuracy or a certified audio/video offset measurement. Windowing, piano attack envelopes, chords and repeated rhythms can shift peaks by tens of milliseconds. The result does not support a large clock error; do not change the frozen benchmark or labels from these exploratory peaks.
